subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp use this narrow blanket suppression for unmentioned non-command group runs, or should maintainers prefer the broader visible-delivery typing boundary before changing automatic group behavior?
rationale: Both approaches address the false composing signal, but they make different user-visible typing tradeoffs for proactive visible replies and the broader approach changes more runtime/API surface.

options.title: Refresh The Narrow Mitigation
options.body: Rebase this PR onto the current admitted-message dispatch path and keep the focused WhatsApp-only behavior change for maintainer review.

options.title: Prefer Visible-Delivery Typing
options.body: Pause this PR and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 only after its conflicts and compatibility/API review are resolved.

options.title: Keep Current Main For Now
options.body: Decline both typing behavior changes until a fresh live WhatsApp repro or clearer UX contract justifies the tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Refresh The Narrow Mitigation
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR onto the current admitted-message dispatch path and keep the focused WhatsApp-only behavior change for maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the broader visible-delivery PR and has recent merged history in the same WhatsApp inbound-dispatch surface.
